question: Entered as a new candidate in R08's game backtest, does the lineup model predict real game margins better than ridge on the same stints and than R08's metrics, on the lineup model's held-out seasons 2023-24 to 2025-26?
inputs: GAMES AND R08 CANDIDATES: courtlens-metric-backtest-v1's pinned tables for 2022-23 (calibration) and 2023-24 to 2025-26 (parameters.v1_table_sha256, read and hash-checked, never changed), restricted to games with R01 stints: 1,229, 1,216, 1,212 and 1,227 games (1, 14, 18 and 3 of R08's games have no admitted stints and are left out). R08's nine candidates are computed by R08's own code (metric_backtest_runner.design and metric_backtest_data.strength) on those games: actual box minutes, its replacement rule, its sources.

LINEUP CANDIDATES: game strengths written by courtlens-lineup-model-v1's `test` (file hash recorded in its results and checked here). lineup_model: sum over all the game's R01 stints of (stint seconds / 2,880) x the lineup model's predicted margin per 100 at a neutral site, from the fit for that season (trained on the three seasons before it; 2022-23 from its selection-season fit, used only for calibration). lineup_ridge: the same sum from the ridge fitted on the same stints with the same inputs and weights, so lineup_model against lineup_ridge isolates the interaction term at game level. Both use who actually played together (the stints), as R08 uses actual minutes; for an additive model this equals the minutes-weighted sum.

No margin of any 2022-23 to 2025-26 game was summarised for any candidate on this game set before this registration; a dry run of the code used R08's tables with margins replaced by random noise and random strengths.
method: R08's method, imported unchanged: margin = a x H + b x D, H = 0 only in the bubble; a, b and the residual SD fitted by least squares on the latest earlier season in which the candidate exists (lineup candidates: 2022-23 for 2023-24, then the previous season); P(home win) = Phi(margin / SD); scores margin RMSE (the verdict), winner accuracy, Brier, log loss, calibration error.
Test seasons 2023-24 to 2025-26 for every candidate available there; projected_impact 2024-25 and 2025-26 (R08's rule); box_prior_rapm 2023-24 and 2025-26 (no 2024-25 source).

Paired game bootstrap with R08's code and seed (2,000 replicates, SeedSequence([8008, starting year])), every candidate on the same draws within a season; 95% intervals for every score and every pairwise gain.

REGISTERED VERDICT RULE (R08's, unchanged): 'A predicts game margins better than B' if and only if the pooled 95% interval of B's RMSE minus A's lies entirely above zero AND A has the lower RMSE in more than half of their common seasons; otherwise no ranking. Intervals are not adjusted for the 55 pairs. The pairs the page leads with are fixed here: lineup_model against lineup_ridge, time_decay (R08's best), time_decay_opener (the same season-start information set) and team_net.
selection: None. Candidates, game set, calibration rule, scores, seed and verdict rule are fixed here; the lineup model's own choices were made on its selection seasons under courtlens-lineup-model-v1. PRIOR KNOWLEDGE, disclosed: R08 published every R08 candidate's RMSE on these seasons over all of R08's games (for example monthly time decay 14.15, 14.15 and 14.54); this game set drops 35 of those games.
uncertainty: Paired game bootstrap within each test season, 2,000 replicates, R08's seed; pooled values resample each season within itself. Calibration a, b and SD are held fixed, and the lineup fits are held fixed, so intervals describe test-game sampling only.
evaluation: Per candidate and season: games, RMSE, accuracy, Brier, log loss, mean error with intervals, calibration season and coefficients; pooled per candidate with a calibration curve.
All 55 pairs on common seasons with per-season and pooled gains and the registered verdict; the lineup model's verdict against every other candidate; any candidate ranked above all others.
acceptance: Comparative: published whichever way it goes.
Fails if an R08 table, the lineup results or the game strengths differ from their hashes, or a calibration fit is rank-deficient.
Two runs give the same results hash.
courtlens-metric-backtest-v1 and its frozen results are not changed.
limitations: Actual minutes and actual lineups are hindsight by design (as in R08): this tests ratings, not pregame forecasts.
Season-start lineup fits are compared with monthly time-decay snapshots, which update within the season; time_decay_opener is the same-information comparison.
Three test seasons; 35 of R08's games are left out because they have no stints.
55 pairwise intervals are unadjusted for multiplicity.
negative_result_policy: Publish every number whatever it shows, including the lineup model losing to ridge, to R08's metrics or to the team baseline.
